preconditions.description: If the input is a non-positive integer, the function must handle it as a special case.

postconditions.description: Each line in the output string must be a single continuous sequence of digits with no spaces.

postconditions.expression: all(line == ''.join(str(n - i + 1) for i in range(1, k + 1)) for k, line in enumerate(return_value.splitlines(), 1) if k <= n)
postconditions.description: For each line k (1 ≤ k ≤ n), the line must be the concatenation of digits from n down to n - k + 1.
If the input is non-positive, the output must be an empty string; otherwise, it must be the constructed pattern.
